task_description: Scrape data from a React single-page application
failure_reason: Static HTTP requests cannot access content rendered by JavaScript frameworks
lesson: React/Vue/Angular SPAs require browser automation for scraping
suggested_approach: Use Playwright or Selenium instead of requests/BeautifulSoup

task_description: Run LangGraph tool call with malformed JSON output
failure_reason: Tool parser failed due to invalid escaped quotes in model output
lesson: Enforce strict JSON mode and schema validation before tool execution
suggested_approach: Use structured output parser with retries and validation

task_description: Agent loops endlessly in reflection step
failure_reason: No max-iteration guard caused repeated self-critique cycle
lesson: Always set iteration limits in graph loops
suggested_approach: Set max steps and add early exit conditions
